purpose: Explain fixture versus live evidence, Architecture and Structure modes, filters, refresh, search, camera controls, local browser preview, navigation, node details, renderer status, fallback behavior, and the strict read-only ownership boundary.
display_lines: Project Structure 3D is a read-only visual map of canonical project evidence.
Check the project label and source badge before relying on the graph.
Architecture and Structure modes show different views of the same source snapshot.
Filters change visible content and do not modify evidence.
The viewer does not edit source files or become validation authority.
